question: Can the s043 body-twin map be turned into a usable canonical(q0, omega) search-space-dedup primitive that is algebraically and bit-exact under the post-fix forward model?
hypothesis: A canonical-hemisphere map with sign normalisation is idempotent, collapses twin pairs, and reproduces hi-fi LC equivalence bit-exactly.
narrative_md: Implemented lib.twin.canonical(q0, omega) + vectorised canonical_batch from the s043 body-twin finding.
